app._pins: Each pin is one commit of the app repo and the sha256 of every release-notes file read at it. 1.2.2 and ios-1.0.2 are read at c884e68a83c2, the head of mars-dawn#673, which was merged on 2026-11-11 (the commit is on the app repo's main, and main's two files still have these sha256s): when either file changes in the app repo, set the new commit and sha256s here and run the ingester again.

asc.what: App Store Connect read, GET only, of every Mac version's localizations and What's New (tools/release/asc.py, 2026-11-06, #266)

dates.rule: the date the App Store's version history gives (its <time datetime>, the UTC date of the timestamp below); the tw storefront gives the same dates

ios._pending: A pending version is not on the App Store yet: its What's New is the release-notes file at the pin (sha256 held) and its date is 'released' here, the due date of the milestone 'Mac 1.2.2 + iOS 1.0.2 live' until the day it ships (then set the real date). The ASC read and the public page are not consulted. The build, the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt and the home page's softwareVersion leave a pending version out: it appears nowhere in public/ (check_app_changelog.py --no-pending-in-public). To ship: drop 'pending', set 'released' to the App Store's UTC date, add released_at_store, run the ingester, rebuild; an iOS version then takes its date from ios.dates.url, as a Mac one does from dates.url. The steps are in scripts/tmde130/ingest.py's docstring.

dates.rule: the same as the Mac page's; no iOS version has been read from it yet (1.0.0 and 1.0.1 are on the page but not listed on /changelog/)
